properties.state: {"description":"A content-addressed store for what the graph cannot hold inline — session transcripts, mermaid diagrams, HTML mockups, user-supplied drawings and photographs, and the source documents a corpus was extracted from. Built on `object_store` (Apache Arrow) with the local filesystem backend and cloud features OFF, so there is no service to run and cloud backends stay one configuration change away.
